text:
Leah M: Quick follow-up from the prefix-cache churn postmortem. Need concrete owners, Jira tracking, and a short RACI so this doesn't go dark. Who volunteers for remediation?
Evan R: I can take the lead on the remediation (tune eviction thresholds + sliding-window heuristics).
Priya S: I'll own test coverage and monitoring changes (canary + synthetic load).
Diego V: I'll be accountable for infra rollout and capacity validation.
Leah M: Can someone open an epic so we have a single source of truth? Prefer to link subtasks for analysis / infra / QA / docs.
ops-bot: Created ticket PJ-9012: "Prefix-cache churn remediation epic" (https://jira.redwood.ai/browse/PJ-9012)
Evan R: Created subtasks: PJ-9013 (data analysis + heatmap of evictions), PJ-9014 (eviction alg prototype), PJ-9015 (config flags + runtime tests).
Priya S: I'll add PJ-9016 (canary plan + perf regressions) and PJ-9017 (dashboard + alert rules). Linking to epic now.
Leah M: RACI draft: Responsible=Evan, Accountable=Diego, Consulted=Priya, Informed=eng-oncall + product. Please put that as a comment on PJ-9012.
Diego V: Agreed. Also add an owner for rollback criteria (Priya?) and a post-release verification owner.
Priya S: I can own rollback criteria and post-release verification. Suggested canary: 2% traffic, 72h observation window, synthetic spike tests before ramp.
Evan R: Timeline suggestion: analysis in 3 business days, prototype and config flags in next sprint, infra rollout in sprint+1.
Leah M: Also add a recurrence/forensics task to confirm this is the same pattern that's spiking every Tuesday at ~8am PT for the last 10 weeks. Evan, can you take that?
Evan R: Assigned PJ-9018 "recurrence analysis: weekly Tue 8am spikes" to myself. I'll post a small notebook and summary by Friday.
Diego V: We'll need a Dedicated infra soak test for the prototype. Evan, please coordinate with @infra-team and add timing to the epic.
Evan R: Will create a shared doc and schedule a 30m sync with infra.
Priya S: Rollout checklist I'm adding to PJ-9016: canary, synthetic load, alert smoke, perf baseline, biz-signoff. I'll tick off items in the epic as we go.
Leah M: Who closes the epic after verification? Recommend Priya verifies and Diego marks the epic closed after infra confirms prod state.
Priya S: I'll mark Verified after 72h canary and synthetic checks.
Diego V: I'll close PJ-9012 after infra validation and add a short closure note in #postmortems.
Leah M: Please each add acceptance criteria to your subtasks by EOD Monday. If no blockers, target the analysis milestone end-of-week.
Evan R: I'll add ACs to PJ-9013 and PJ-9014 by EOD Mon.
Priya S: ACs for PJ-9016 and PJ-9017 posted.
Diego V: Infra ACs posted to PJ-9015.
Leah M: Thanks — I'll run a weekly triage until the epic is closed. :thumbsup:
Evan R: Flagging as high-priority; will escalate if we see a repeat before fixes.
Priya S: Adding a temporary regression alert to catch early signs.
Leah M: Next check-in Wednesday 11:00 PT in this thread.
ops-bot: Reminder scheduled: Postmortem follow-up check-in 2D Wed 11:00 PT (3187960800)
